test_title: PYST 26: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements about the National Mission on Natural Farming (NMNF), launched in 2024, is/are correct?

1. NMNF aims to reach 1 crore farmers and cover 7.5 lakh ha. Model Demonstration Farms will be set up only at Agricultural Universities.

2. Natural Farming practices aim to reduce dependency on externally purchased inputs.

3. It is a Central Sector Scheme under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Only 1 and 3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Mission on Natural Farming (NMNF)** was launched to promote **Natural Farming practices**, emphasizing the reduction of dependency on externally purchased inputs such as fertilizers and pesticides.
 
• NMNF aims to encourage farmers to adopt **chemical-free and eco-friendly farming practices** that enhance soil health and improve crop yield.
 
• The mission targets reaching **1 crore farmers** and covering **7.5 lakh hectares** of land.
 
• The focus of Natural Farming includes practices such as **composting, mulching, bio-fertilizers, and bio-pesticides**, which align with sustainable agricultural goals.
 
• The scheme is implemented as a **Central Sector Scheme** under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare, ensuring direct participation and funding by the central government.
 
• Model Demonstration Farms are not limited to Agricultural Universities; they are established at various locations, including farms of progressive farmers and agricultural institutions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Incorrect Option: Model Demonstration Farms**__

 __
 
• The statement that **Model Demonstration Farms will be set up only at Agricultural Universities** is incorrect. These farms are established across diverse locations, including **farms owned by progressive farmers**, agricultural research institutes, and other demonstration sites.
 
• This ensures widespread dissemination of Natural Farming practices and makes the mission more accessible to farmers in different regions.
 
 
 
• **Incorrect Option: Central Sector Scheme**__
 
 
• NMNF is indeed a **Central Sector Scheme**, meaning it is fully funded by the central government. This ensures streamlined implementation and greater accountability.
 
• Such schemes are crucial for promoting nationwide initiatives like Natural Farming, especially in areas where chemical-intensive farming has led to soil degradation.
